title: Reliable Tailscale installation on fresh CloudlessOS systems
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-9a fixes Tailscale installation on fresh DGX Spark systems and keeps installation progress, failures, retries, and support evidence accurate.
changes: Verify the official Tailscale repository key inside a private writable GPG workspace so the hardened installer works correctly when the root home directory is read-only.
Preserve the real verification failure instead of incorrectly reporting an internal GPG error as a repository fingerprint mismatch.

Keep Tailscale installation progress and actionable failures visible in Remote Access, allow explicit retries after systemd start limits, and include installer evidence in Cloudless support diagnostics.
Add fresh ARM64 installation regression coverage using a protected read-only home while preserving the permissions of Cloudless's privileged runtime directory.
